snapshot_id.description: Default is the repository's current snapshot.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. description: Doc mentions that no longer name real code: a Markdown doc's inline code or link that resolved in an earlier snapshot and names nothing now, each with its file and line, and renamed, moved or moved_renamed with the new name when the symbol was paired by body hash, else deleted.
